Motion reference clip: a plain smooth grey artist's mannequin figure, short and chubby with a large round head (child proportions), standing upright on two legs, strict side view facing right, full body visible with plenty of empty space above the head and around it.
It performs FOUR actions one after another, in exactly this timing:
0.0–1.0 s: looks back — standing still, it turns its head over its shoulder to look behind itself (to the left), holds the look for a moment, then turns its head back to face right.
1.0–2.0 s: raises a lantern — the front arm, bent at the elbow, lifts slowly from hip height up high above the head as if holding up a lantern to light something, holds it up, then lowers it back down quickly.
2.0–3.0 s: scratches a sign — it leans slightly forward and the front arm reaches forward at chest height; the hand makes short quick scratching strokes up and down and sideways on an invisible wall right in front of it, the other arm hangs still.
3.0–4.0 s: crouches to hide — it bends its knees deeply and sinks into a low hunched crouch, head pulled down between the shoulders, and STAYS crouched to the end, breathing softly.
Every action happens ON THE SPOT: the figure never travels across the frame, it stays centered. Each action is clearly separated and finished before the next one starts.
Camera: locked static camera, no zoom, no pan, orthographic side view, the figure the same size throughout and always fully inside the frame.
Background: flat solid bright green #00FF00, evenly lit, no shadows, no floor, no props, no text.

<Picture 1> is a painted fox wanderer in a hooded olive cloak, with a leather satchel and a small glowing lantern held in his paw. Animate <Picture 1> performing exactly the same four actions with the same timing as the grey figure in <Video 1>: calm breathing idle, walking on the spot, running on the spot, jumping straight up and landing.
He is ANTHROPOMORPHIC and BIPEDAL: upright on his TWO hind legs in every frame, front legs are ARMS that never touch the ground, never on all fours. The lantern stays in his front paw in EVERY frame, he never lets go of it. Mouth closed: he is silent, he does not speak or sing.
Every action happens ON THE SPOT: he never travels across the frame, he stays centered and fully inside the frame, feet always on the same invisible ground line.
Camera: locked static camera, no zoom, no pan, orthographic side view facing right, the character the same size throughout.
Style: keep the exact painted storybook look, colours and outfit of <Picture 1>. Background: one flat solid magenta #FF00FF that never changes colour or brightness, no shadows, no ground, no light rays, no glow on the background, no particles, no props, no text.
